name: HDR Image Preprocessing Pipeline
definition: A data preprocessing pipeline to convert bracketed LDR exposures into normalized 32-bit HDR images for NeRF training, involving alignment, CRF recovery, downsampling, and linear normalization.
summary: The HDR Image Preprocessing Pipeline converts bracketed LDR exposures into normalized 32-bit HDR radiance images by recovering the camera response function and preserving relative intensity differences for stable deep learning training.
